name: manual_566a72
claim: In a partial or not-yet-materialized remote checkout, treat apparent mass deletion as checkout-state ambiguity until the exact remote ref and objects are fetched and materialized; do not repair or publish from git status alone.

decisions.notes: A PR #388 follow-up session directly observed a partial/no-checkout worktree report widespread tracked deletions that disappeared after the exact PR ref was fetched and checked out.

rationale: A PR #388 follow-up session directly observed a partial/no-checkout worktree report widespread tracked deletions that disappeared after the exact PR ref was fetched and checked out.
